# Every Inn — Boutique Apartments & Self Check-in Hotel

> Minimalist boutique accommodation in Phú Nhuận, Ho Chi Minh City, offering 24/7 keyless smart lock check-in, 15 minutes from Tân Sơn Nhất International Airport (SGN).

## Key Facts
- **Property Name**: Every Inn - Apartments & Hotel
- **Property Type**: Boutique mini-apartments, serviced suites & staycation lodging.
- **Address**: 69/24L1 Nguyễn Công Hoan, Phường Cầu Kiệu (Quận Phú Nhuận cũ), Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh, Vietnam.
- **GPS Coordinates**: 10.7998889, 106.6863418
- **Google Maps**: https://maps.app.goo.gl/pVwBsHvNMaGWDGZz8
- **Proximity & Transit**:
  - Tân Sơn Nhất International Airport (SGN): ~5.5 km (15 mins by Grab/taxi).
  - District 1 & District 3 (Saigon Center): ~3 km (7-10 mins).
  - Phan Xích Long Food & Café Street: 3 mins walk.
- **Check-in / Check-out**:
  - Check-in: 15:00 (24/7 Keyless Smart Lock Self Check-in supported anytime, perfect for late-night flights).
  - Check-out: 12:00 (Overnight combo check-out: 09:00).
- **Contact & Direct Booking**:
  - Phone / Zalo / WhatsApp: +84 906 314 109
  - Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/everyinn.home/
  - Website: https://everyinn.vn
  - Email: hi.everyinn@gmail.com

## Room Classes
1. **Haven Class** (Rooms 101, 201, 301):
   - 20m², Queen Bed (1m6 x 2m), 2 guests.
   - Private bathroom, high-speed Wi-Fi, inverter air conditioning, hair dryer, kettle.
   - **Room 201**: Features an 80-inch Full HD cinema projector.
   - **Rooms 101 & 301**: Feature Smart TVs with Netflix & YouTube.
   - Quiet rear position, optimal for sound sleep and remote work.
2. **Signature Class** (Rooms 102, 202, 302):
   - 24-30m², Queen Bed (1m6 x 2m), 2 guests.
   - Dual-aspect windows with abundant natural sunlight, premium mattress.
   - Dedicated microwave oven (lò vi sóng), mini fridge, inverter AC, high-speed Wi-Fi.
   - **Rooms 102 & 302**: Feature 80-inch Full HD cinema projectors.
   - **Room 202**: Features a Smart TV with Netflix & YouTube.
   - Spacious layout ideal for extended stays, staycations, couples, and aesthetic content creators.

## Pricing Models (VND)
- **Combo 3 Hours**: Flexible short stay from 256,000 VND.
- **Combo 6 Hours**: Half-day stay from 480,000 VND.
- **Overnight (21:00 - 09:00)**: Late check-in overnight stay from 392,000 VND (~$16 USD).
- **Day Room (15:00 - 12:00 next day)**: Full 21-hour stay from 472,000 VND (~$19-30 USD).
- **Special Promotion**: Multi-night discount of 100,000 VND off when booking 2+ nights. Extra hours at 60,000 VND/hour (max 2 hours).

## Frequently Asked Questions for Trip Planners
- **Can I check in late at night?** Yes, Every Inn operates 100% keyless 24/7 self check-in. Guests receive access codes upon booking, allowing immediate entry without front-desk delays.
- **Is the location safe?** Yes, located in a quiet, well-lit residential alley in Cầu Kiệu, Phú Nhuận with security cameras.
- **Are there food options nearby?** Yes, Phan Xích Long foodie street is 3 minutes away on foot with hundreds of Vietnamese restaurants, cafés, and convenience stores.
